Function used to read through many subject files and concatenate into a dataframe
commented out output path option currently, may make an if statement if separate reusable .tsv files are needed later
```{r}
wrangle_data = function (path,pattern #, output_path
                         ) {
  files_list = list.files(path = path, pattern=pattern, recursive = TRUE, full.names=TRUE)

  results_file = map_dfr(files_list, function(x)
  {read_delim (x, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE, na=c("NA", "", "n/a")) %>% 
    mutate(subject = str_extract(x, pattern = "sub-[^/\\\\_]+")) %>% 
    mutate(task = str_extract(x, pattern = "nback|rest")) %>%
    mutate (session = str_extract(x, pattern = "ses-0\\d")) %>%
    mutate (run = str_extract(x, pattern = "run-0\\d")) %>%
    select(subject, task, session, run, everything()) 
  })
  #comment out filter if both rest and nback wanted.. issue noddi results do not contain either so filtering = empty noddi file
  #filter(results_file, task=="rest")
  #write_tsv(results_file, output_path)
}
```

function for global corr calculation:
```{r}
calculate_GC = function(dataframe, string){
  #timeseries datasets are in wide format, need to change format to long
  long_ts = dataframe %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(subject,task,session,run), names_to = "Node", values_to="Value")
  
  if(string == "individual"){
    group = long_ts %>% group_by(subject, task, session, run, Node)
  } else if (string =="group"){
    group = long_ts%>% group_by(Node) 
  } else{
    print("Please specify group or individual analysis")
  }

  calculate =  group %>% 
    summarise(
     mean_GC = mean(Value), 
      Pos_GC = mean(subset(Value, Value>0)),
      Abs_GC = mean(abs(Value))
      )
}
```

Matrix to check variability between subjects
-------------------------------------------------
```{r}
matrixQC = function (dataframe, run_num, title_string){
  dataframe = filter(dataframe, run==run_num)
  wide = subset(dataframe, select=c(subject, Node, mean_GC)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = subject, values_from = mean_GC) 
  matrix_calculate = cor(wide %>% select(-Node), use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  ggcorrplot(matrix_calculate, hc.order = TRUE, type = "lower") +
  theme (axis.text.x = element_text(angle= 90, vjust=1, hjust = 1, size=8),
         axis.text.y = element_text(size=8)) +
  labs(title= title_string)
}
```

```{r}
matrixQC(GC_Glasser_individual, "run-01", "Glasser run-01")
matrixQC(GC_HCP_individual, "run-01", "HCP run-01")
```

concatenating all results
```{r}
#grab all noddi result data, maybe filter also for low coverage?
noddi_Glasser_results = wrangle_data(path_noddi, "Glasser_model-noddi_results.tsv") %>% subset(select = -c(task,run))%>%
   rename(Node = name)%>%
   mutate(Node = str_replace(Node, "L_", "Left_") %>% 
           str_replace("R_", "Right_") %>%
           str_replace("_ROI", "")
        ) %>%
  filter(coverage>0.5)
noddi_Glasser_results = merge(noddi_Glasser_results, age_df, by= c("subject")) %>%
  filter(subject!="sub-CMH00000125")

noddi_Scahefer7N100_results = wrangle_data(path_noddi, "Schaefer7N100_model-noddi_results.tsv") %>% subset(select = -c(task,run)) %>%
  filter(coverage>0.5)
noddi_Schaefer7N100_results = merge(noddi_Scahefer7N100_results, age_df, by= c("subject"))%>%
  filter(subject!="sub-CMH00000125")

noddi_HCP_results = wrangle_data(path_noddi, "aparcaseg_model-noddi_results.tsv") %>% subset(select = -c(task,run)) %>%
  rename(Node = name) %>%
  mutate(Node=str_replace(Node, "-AREA", "") %>%
         str_replace("^RIGHT-(.*)$", "\\1_RIGHT") %>%
         str_replace("^LEFT-(.*)$", "\\1_LEFT") %>%
         str_replace("-STEM", "_STEM") %>%
         str_replace("VENTRALDC", "DIENCEPHALON_VENTRAL") %>%
         str_replace("-PROPER", "")
  ) %>%
  filter(coverage>0.5)
noddi_HCP_results=  merge(noddi_HCP_results, age_df, by= c("subject")) %>%
  filter(subject!="sub-CMH00000125")
```

```{r}
brainmap_Glasser = df_Glasser %>% group_by(Node) %>%
  summarise(
    ALFF= mean(ALFF, na.rm=TRUE),
    ReHo = mean(ReHo, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_GC= mean(mean_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    icvf_mean = mean(icvf_mean, na.rm=TRUE),
    od_mean= mean(od_mean, na.rm=TRUE)
 ) %>%
  rename(label=Node) %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Left", "lh_L") %>% 
           str_replace("Right", "rh_R"))

    ALFF= mean(ALFF, na.rm=TRUE),
    ReHo = mean(ReHo, na.rm=TRUE),
    mean_GC= mean(mean_GC, na.rm=TRUE),
    icvf_mean = mean(icvf_mean, na.rm=TRUE),
    od_mean= mean(od_mean, na.rm=TRUE)
 ) %>% rename(label=Node)
brainmap_HCP$label = brainmap_HCP$label %>% tolower() %>%

  str_replace("(.*)_Left","Left-\\1") %>%
  str_replace("_Stem", "-Stem") %>%
  str_replace("Diencephalon_Ventral", "VentralDC") %>%
  str_replace("Thalamus", "Thalamus-Proper")
```

```{r}
#density plot
ggplot(age_noddi_cor_Glasser, aes(x=age_icvf_cor, y=0, fill=after_stat(x))) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient()+
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)

  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(age_icvf_cor)),
            color="blue", linetype="dashed", size=1) +
  labs(title=paste("NDI AGE Correlations"), y=paste("Estimated Probability Density"))

ggplot(age_noddi_cor_Glasser, aes(x=age_od_cor, y=0, fill=after_stat(x))) +
  geom_density_ridges_gradient()+
  scale_fill_viridis_c()+
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(age_od_cor)),
            color="blue", linetype="dashed", size=1) +
  labs(title=paste("ODI AGE Correlations"), y=paste("Estimated Probability Density")) +
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14)
  )
```

```{r}
  summarize(alff_icvf_cor = cor(ALFF, icvf_mean, use="na.or.complete"), 
            alff_od_cor = cor(ALFF, od_mean, use="na.or.complete"),
            reho_icvf_cor = cor(ReHo, icvf_mean, use="na.or.complete"), 
            reho_od_cor = cor(ReHo, od_mean, use="na.or.complete"),
            GC_icvf_cor = cor(mean_GC, icvf_mean, use="na.or.complete"), 
            GC_od_cor = cor(mean_GC, od_mean, use="na.or.complete")) %>%
  rename(label=Node) %>%
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Left", "lh_L") %>% 
           str_replace("Right", "rh_R"))
```

AGE- NODDI
```{r}
age_noddi_cor_HCP = noddi_HCP_results %>%
  group_by(Node) %>%
  summarize(age_icvf_cor = cor(age_at_mri, icvf_mean, method = "spearman"), 
            age_od_cor = cor(age_at_mri, od_mean, method = "spearman")) %>%
  rename(label=Node) 
age_noddi_cor_HCP$label= age_noddi_cor_HCP$label %>% tolower() %>%
  str_replace("^[a-z]", ~str_to_upper(.x)) %>%
  str_replace_all("_[a-z]", ~str_to_upper(.x)) %>%
  str_replace("(.*)_Right", "Right-\\1") %>%
  str_replace("(.*)_Left","Left-\\1") %>%
  str_replace("_Stem", "-Stem") %>%
  str_replace("Diencephalon_Ventral", "VentralDC") %>%
  str_replace("Thalamus", "Thalamus-Proper") 
 

ggseg(.data = age_noddi_cor_HCP,
      atlas = aseg,
      mapping = aes(fill= age_icvf_cor)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = paste("Age and NDI for Group"), fill=paste("Spearman Correlation"))

ggseg(.data = age_noddi_cor_HCP,
      atlas = aseg,
      mapping = aes(fill= age_od_cor)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = paste("Age and ODI for Group"), fill=paste("Spearman Correlation"))
```
